sources.title: Autoencoder Training | xandergos/terrain-diffusion | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page describes the training process for the VAE-based autoencoder that provides 8× spatial compression for terrain data. The autoencoder reduces 128×128 pixel terrain residuals to 16×16 latent representations, enabling efficient training of the base and decoder diffusion models. sources.snippet: InfiniteDiffusion breaks this trilemma, transforming any diffusion model into an infinite, logically stateless array, indexed only by seed and coordinates, supporting O (1) random access, full determinism, and embarrassing parallelism.

This repo provides: InfiniteDiffusion, a drop-in replacement for MultiDiffusion that makes diffusion sampling lazy and unbounded, with O (1) random access and seed-consistency (determinism).
